propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion 'decomp-shape' must detect layer-cake decompositions (children partitioned by architectural layer rather than vertical slices) and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge patterns (child consuming sibling output without dependency edge)

The criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), routed with facet 'container' and default posture 'advisory', and integrated into CONTAINER_CRITERIA fan-out via pass1_container without new engine constructs

The eval_solver container-arm must be extended to run container criteria over fixtures carrying a children list, enabling bounded sanity checks via 'rebar criteria eval' with <=8 live single-criterion container runs total

Blocking promotion is gated by both standing per-criterion effectiveness metrics (high detection_proxy, low false-positive rate) AND E6 judge order-stability reaching floor (fleiss_kappa>=0.6), which currently fails at 0.55

All acceptance criteria must be met: registration non-orphan status verified, deterministic unit tests passing, bounded sanity fixtures committed with perfect recall and zero false-accepts on negatives, auto-inclusion in effectiveness recorder, and promotion gate documented
